about: Labelled changes for the tamper guard (ADR 0042, ADR 0044). expect lists the kinds of finding a case must give; an empty list means none. Each case is a git repo whose main branch has base and whose working tree on a branch has head (null deletes a file). The cases were written together with the guard: their counts show it does what the ADRs say, not a measured false-positive or miss rate (M26 measures that).
